participant_id.Description: De-identified participant label (I = instructed protocol, F = free protocol)

protocol.Description: Experimental protocol the participant took part in

sex.Description: Sex as recorded by the experimenters

source_folder.Description: Name of the participant folder in the original data collection folders

source_session_number.Description: Participant number used in the EmotivPRO session names of the original recordings. Equal to the folder number in both instructed protocol and free protocol
